name: TC-53 Verify registration password policy validation [Length < 8]
description: Verify that entering an invalid password displays the correct validation error.
descriptionHtml: Verify that entering an invalid password displays the correct validation error.

testStage.description: Verify that entering an invalid password displays the correct validation error.

steps.name: Precondition: Open Registration modal via user menu
Check if Registration modal is displayed
Check if Registration modal is displayed
1. Enter valid baseline data into all fields except Password
2. Enter invalid password and observe validation error
Wait for validation error to appear
Get all displayed validation error messages in the form

parameters.value: 'Пароль не може бути коротшим, ніж 8 та довшим, ніж 20 символів'
